title: Slovakian Pork Skewers
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian-inspired dish featuring juicy pork skewers, perfect for a warm evening. These skewers are marinated in a mix of traditional Slovakian spices and herbs, then grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: make sure to cut the pork into uniform pieces for even cooking

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.notes: Hungarian or regular paprika works well

instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 375°F.
Thread the pork cubes, onion, garlic, bell pepper, and zucchini onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
